text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Entrusted to gods supreme,
may our ancient path 
flourish, lasting for ages hereafter ——

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
O mighty and revered three pillars,
witness my dance till its end. 
Draw near, draw near,
heed the resolve set in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Proud and noble spirits,
swaying gracefully, 
swayed by flame. Rage throughout heaven 
and earth, burn bright,
lead us to prosperity.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—— I am chronicler of tale,
I am successor of legacy.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Ah～～～ Fall really is prime eating season… Oh, that reminds me, isn't the Festival of Illustrious Equines coming up? Wonder what's on the agenda this year.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Responsibilities for the various performances
were rotated 
between the different horsegirl communities,
right? I'm curious 
if Tracen Academy has received its assignments
yet～

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Appointment! The five of you have been selected to perform in the Votive Stage Play at this year's Festival of Illustrious Equines!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —— Tokai Teio! Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—— Kawakami Princess! King Halo! 
Haru Urara! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? Meee, in the Votive Stage Play!? 
… What exactly is a "Votive Stage Play"?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Vo-ti-ve, vo-te… Voting? Are they going 
to choose who the best actress was!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Why would you think that!
It means offering in devotion! 
This is a sacred ceremony of the Festival
of Illustrious Equines! …… So,
this year Tracen Academy is in charge of
it?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative!
The Votive Stage Play is a play offered to
the three goddesses!
A traditional ceremonial performance art,
enacting 
horsegirl folklore passed down from ancient
times!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wow～! Sounds like a prestigious honor!
If I recall correctly, 
aren't performers for the Votive Stage Play
chosen through 
some sort of divination process?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm. Choosing me,
huh? Seems the gods have good taste! 
Hehe～ We gotta go brag to Prez about this♪

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
There's also a preparation camp coming up
for this stage play! High expectations!
As representatives of Tracen Academy, 
I hope you'll dedicate yourselves to the
task!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
<color=#ff99d0>Prez!
Guess what～～!!</color> 
<color=#f5cd47>President,
you've got to hear this～～!!</color>

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
<color=#ff99d0>I'm gonna be in the Votive
Stage Play at the festival!! </color> 
<color=#f5cd47>I've been chosen for the
Votive Stage Play at the
festival!!</color>

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Oh boy～ We sure gave her a laugh, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it,
it's obvious that Prez would know 
about us being chosen.
The student council is always involved 
in organizing the Festival of Illustrious
Equines, of course.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But still,
Prez said she's looking forward to it!
If I nail this, 
I bet she'll start seeing me in a new
light!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Even though I don't know exactly what
we'll be doing yet,
I want to show the president something 
really amazing and totally surprise her!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Let's gooo!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Preparation camp sounds fun～! I wonder 
what kind of play we'll be performing??

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Remember, it's not just any play;
it's a sacred ceremony of high standing.
The performance varies each year,
so we can't 
be sure what we're in for… But we've got to
take it seriously.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
High standing… Whooa,
that really pumps me up! 
Let's do this with elegance and grace!
Knock it out of the ——

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wait, does that mean I'll be sharing 
the stage with Madam King…?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
? Yes, that's right. 
A suitable first-class stage, for us to ——

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—— Whaaat!?
S-Sharing the stage with Madam King!? 
Together!? Is that really happening!?!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Madam King!
I'll give it everything I've got! 
With all my heart!! Full throttle!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Uh, yes, let's do our best…?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Sharing the stage… with Madam King……! Hmhmhm～♪ Hmhmhm～～♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Kawakami looks excited, doesn't she!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ……… I wonder if she's really up for it.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Training camp, training camp～ La-dee-da～♪ 
Finally, tomorrow,
wa-ha-ha～! I'm so excited!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Goodness,
it's not like we're going on a vacation,
you know…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
We've been given a very honorable task.
We need to stay 
focused and make sure we do our roles
justice.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As a first-class horsegirl,
I must deliver a first-class 
rendition of this "Votive Stage Play"……!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
……… You're really fired up, aren't you,
King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
…… Absolutely.
We need to get to bed early tonight to 
prep for tomorrow.
Let's hurry and finish packing.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Roger that! Clothes and～ my hug pillow～… 
Oh, should I bring playing cards too? 
It'll be fun to play together!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I told you, it's not a vacation!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Wooow, this is where we're having our training camp!!? I'm so psyched, let's do thiiiiii—ughuh! uaghah!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tsuru, you and your sudden sprints～! 
Here, have some water.

—— Hehe, what a lively group. 
Welcome, Tracen Academy attendees.

text_block_list.name: Votive Play Instructor
text_block_list.text: I'm with the Horsegirl Ritual Arts Association, and I will be serving as your instructor for this preparation camp. I look forward to working with you all.

text_block_list.name: All Together
text_block_list.text:
We look forward to receiving your
teachings!!
